name: python-merkle-proofs
title: Merkle Proofs
blurb: Merkle inclusion proofs where a leaf and an internal node can never be confused. Leaves are hashed with a 0x00 prefix and nodes with a 0x01 prefix, so a node's digest is not a valid leaf digest and the classic second-preimage forgery stops working; the tree splits at the largest power of two below the leaf count, so its shape - and therefore its root - does not depend on how the builder felt about odd counts. A proof carries one sibling per level and is bound to an index and a size: move it to another slot and the recomputed root disagrees. The demo measures the forgery, the tampered leaf, the moved index and the two competing shapes.
default_description: Merkle inclusion proofs with domain-separated hashing, a fixed tree shape, and verifiers that name which rule a proof broke.
